decisions.reason: As a flagship waterproof line close to the core offer, it still holds upside and costs little to carry within an existing range, and there is no evidence that its value has failed to materialize.

ESD occupational shoes are a standard, low-cost addition to a safety footwear portfolio, but as a single model in a firm with many options it is more exposed to range pruning, though the evidence does not yet justify dropping it.

This safety shoe series sits within the established business and is cheap to keep while demand resolves, though safety footwear lines are typically refreshed every few years, so it could be replaced by newer models.
